newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shum Yip debuts at HK$3.175 per share.
newsitem.headline: Shum Yip debuts at HK$3.175 per share.

text.p: Shares of Shenzhen municipal government backed Shum Yip Investment Ltd made their trading debut at HK$3.175 per share compared with their issue price of HK$1.85 each.
Shum Yip issued 250 million new shares at HK$1.85 each, of which 175 million shares were for international placing and 75 million shares for the public in Hong Kong.

Its Hong Kong public offering portion was 438 times subscribed. The company had issued an additional 37.50 million shares to cover overallotment. Shum Yip engages in property development and investment primarily in Shenzhen in China across the border from Hong Kong. It also provides transportation services in China, and between Hong Kong and China.
